description: Header file defining the SimpleSoftOMXComponent class, which extends SoftOMXComponent, including its data structures, methods, and internal logic for OMX component management in Android's media framework.

classes.name: SimpleSoftOMXComponent
classes.description: A class representing a simple software OMX component, managing ports, buffers, states, and message handling within Android's media framework.
